newsitem.title: INDIA: India Oct copper cathode output 4,050 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: India Oct copper cathode output 4,050 tonnes.

text.p: India's state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd (HCL) produced 4,050 tonnes of copper cathodes in October against a target of 4,400 tonnes, a Mines Ministry statement said on Monday.
It produced 18,248 tonnes of cathodes between April and October, down sharply from 23,041 tonnes in the same period in 1995 and below the target of 20,100.
The statement said HCL, India's copper monopoly, produced 3,300 tonnes of continuous cast copper wire rod in October against a target of 3,000 tonnes.
Between April and October, HCL produced 22,946 tonnes of wire rods, up from 17,539 tonnes in the same period in the previous year but below the target of 26,000.
